findings.title: Expired refresh tokens are accepted
findings.contract: Expired refresh tokens must be rejected.
findings.trigger: Call validateRefreshToken with exp equal to now minus one second.
findings.observed_behavior: The function returns success because it verifies only the signature.
findings.expected_behavior: The function rejects the token with TOKEN_EXPIRED.
evidence: The changed function has no expiration comparison.
The existing test covers invalid signatures but not expired valid signatures.

evidence_sources.detail: Changed validation path checks signature but not exp.
No expired, validly signed token case.

findings.consequence: A revoked-by-expiry session can be renewed.
findings.required_outcome: Validly signed refresh tokens whose expiration is in the past are rejected and regression tested.
findings.triage_reason: The documented token contract and a direct code path establish the violation.
